items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps skin clean without stripping it.
Adds a light layer of hydration, which can help dull-looking skin look fresher.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the skin barrier and give a smoother-looking finish.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection, which helps keep skin looking even and bright.

response.routine_note: I left out the 30% peel because strong acid peels are best skipped while pregnant, so please check with your prenatal provider or a dermatologist before adding any exfoliating acids. Use the cleanser, hyaluronic serum, moisturizer and SPF in the morning, and the first three at night.
